stderr_matches: \[kuna --jobs\] structsynth: \d+ function\(s\) with synthesized structures named as --jobs 1 --option protoorder off names them: \d+ renamed, \d+ decompile\(s\) again

notes: A serial decompile-all of this fixture synthesizes five struct_N. Workers record every ledger lookup and their own answer, the parent replays the lookups in target order, and each function that synthesized is renamed or decompiled again with the serial names. The pool cannot take the callee-first order, so the line names the serial run it replays.
